title: CustodyJobRequest v2
description: One round trip per 0DTE option contract per ET trading day. The upstream selector chooses symbol, direction and the exact same-day contract; custody only times one entry and one exit from same-day underlying 1m bars. Success is measured on the option fills (docs/STANDARD.md).

strategy_id.description: Registered immutable strategy id (python3 -m custody strategies). Live mode requires status accepted.

symbol.description: Underlying, e.g. SPY or US.SPY. Supplies timing bars only. The same underlying may have several jobs (e.g. a CALL and a PUT).

direction.description: LONG buys the CALL, SHORT buys the PUT. The product never writes options.

contract.description: Exact broker option code expiring on trade_date (0DTE), matching symbol and direction. One job per contract per day.

trade_date.description: Defaults to today in America/New_York and must equal it.
